recap.text: Clay-ton is a rock monster posted behind Crawler Elle McGibbons on the dance floor with his arms folded. He says No closer. Elle moves him aside by hand.

Clay-ton plays upright bass in the house jazz band after his security contract ran out. He puts the bass down for Chris and takes his side. He tells a troll guard named Klonder that late-stage crawlers are not to be stopped.

beats.headline: Elle's rock
beats.text: Subject is a rock monster of the same stamp as the club’s cretins, posted behind Crawler Elle McGibbons on the dance floor with his arms folded. His entire recorded conversation is “No closer.” She moves him aside by hand when she wants to.
beats.gist: Clay-ton is a rock monster bodyguard who tells people no closer and is moved by hand.

beats.headline: Late-stage crawlers you don't stop
beats.text: Subject, formerly security, now plays upright bass in the house jazz band. His contract ran out, he told them he no longer wanted to fight, and they let him play. He puts the bass down when Chris walks in, notes that Chris is different, and takes his side. If the guards stop Chris and Donut and friends, he says, they stop him. Then he explains the job to a troll guard named Klonder: he worked as a guard a very long time. Late-stage crawlers, you do not try to stop.
beats.gist: Clay-ton plays upright bass in the house jazz band until he takes Chris's side.
